method: FM3_PLEX_PRESETS.py --run: per preset, edit-buffer load of the default preset (7F 00) + fn=0x1F read (must equal the default), the user chooses the Plex preset on channel A (front panel or FM3-Edit, no Save), fn=0x1F read saved. The script never stores and never sets.

summary.meaning: Every Plex preset is a measured full-channel image from the device-default start; choosing one changed only channel A. A generator can apply one as a full-channel template (all 96 words), as multidelayTypes does for Multi Delay; the selector word alone fills nothing.

notMeasured: generated load of a Plex template
the fill from a non-default start
